order: Genericize the README's install instructions so they no longer assume the maintainer's own local paths. Replace the hardcoded local path in the install example with a placeholder environment variable, and add a POSIX clone-and-install snippet alongside it so a non-maintainer user has a copy-pasteable path. Rename the internal project-name labels to a neutral harness name. Keep the uninstaller's existing loose-prefix fallback matching the old markers exactly as before, so an install performed under the old name stays fully uninstallable. Add a permissive open-source license file at the repository root and a corresponding license section in the README; state the license terms explicitly rather than leaving them implied. Touch only the README, the install script's label strings, and the new license file, and leave every other functional behavior as it was.
claims: The install example now points at a placeholder environment variable instead of a hardcoded local path, with a POSIX clone-and-install snippet added beside it. Internal labels were renamed to a neutral name while the uninstaller's loose-prefix fallback was left unchanged so it still matches markers from installs under the old name. A permissive license file and a matching README section were added, confined to 4 files with nothing else touched.
